verdict.rationale: Deel documents an official MCP server that exposes payroll data to agents such as Claude and ChatGPT, with tools that map to API operations and return JSON. That covers the 'agent pulls payroll data' part of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes payroll journal entries, GL or accounting exports, or ledger reconciliation, and no listed MCP tool is payroll-specific. missing for 10: documented payroll journal/GL export or API endpoint, specific payroll journal MCP tools, ledger/accounting integration or reconciliation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent pull payroll journal data via API or export and reconcile the entries into my ledger

citations.quote: Expose contracts, people, payroll, and time data to Claude, ChatGPT, or your own agent with Deel's MCP server.
The Deel MCP server exposes tools that map to Deel API operations. Each tool accepts structured input parameters and returns JSON results.
The Deel MCP server exposes Deel platform operations as tools that AI agents and assistants can invoke directly.
